headline: Callahan Stirs Anew as Nevish Leads Night Fighting
war_summary: Since the midnight edition the wires show fresh movement on several fronts while others have gone quiet. The Nevish Line remains the liveliest sector with 56 changes in the day and five in the last two hours to 01:58, standing six Warden and two Colonial posts with day losses of 4,232 Colonial and 4,362 Warden. Callahan's Passage stirs anew with two changes at the 03:16 cutoff after 22 on the day, holding nine Warden and one Colonial post amid 9,815 Colonial and 11,132 Warden losses. The Weathered Expanse records three changes in two hours and 33 on the day to 02:45, now six Colonial and three unheld with 4,767 Colonial and 8,121 Warden losses. Stonecradle shows two changes in two hours to 02:58 for five on the day at one Warden and eight Colonial. Palantine Berm, with 40 changes on the day and ten in six hours but none in two, holds seven Warden posts, last heard at 00:59, while Mooring County is quiet in two hours after six on the day about twelve Warden posts.
